protocol.scope: Exploratory extension; published validation text; earlier Sudoku test already inspected
protocol.text_dead_definition: One empirical code at every position throughout a stratum; unseen codebook entries alone do not count as a dead level
protocol.sudoku_selection: Train-derived positional modal templates; screen individual fixed-template interventions on first 96 validation puzzles. Rank by changed success status, then changed final grids, then level number. Freeze best three before evaluating their joint 9-pass intervention on test.
protocol.sudoku_test_conditions: Selected three individually and jointly, plus joint best two (10 passes), on 600 test and 256 external; contributions retained
protocol.text_primary: Per-level empirical code diversity and positional entropy; variance before/after native pooling; reconstruction over non-padding tokens
protocol.text_controls: Within-four-token-block permutation versus global permutation, same 32 sources; distinguish raw pooled embeddings from residual quantizer inputs and full tokenizer codes
protocol.limits: Two text tokenizers do not establish a universal NCM claim; no text generator is evaluated; no historical training causality or speed benchmark
